body_markdown:
No game day party is complete without crowd-pleasing eats packed with flavor, and we’re here to give your tailgating spread a winning touch with Lifeway. Whether you’re hosting a watch party at home or headed to a stadium to tailgate, upgrading classic fan favorites is easier than ever when you add the magic of cultured dairy.


From creamy, crave-worthy dips and a gut-healthy bowl to zesty burgers and bites, these recipes made with[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) and[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) bring serious flavor, protein, and probiotics to the table. Get ready to tackle hunger and score major points with guests all season long with our ultimate playbook of better-for-you game day eats!


## 9 Game Day Recipes Made With Lifeway Farmer Cheese and Lifeway Kefir


### 1.[Farmer Cheese Jalapeño Poppers](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-jalapeno-poppers/)


We took a game day snack favorite and gave it an upgrade with high protein, probiotic-rich Lifeway Farmer Cheese. Our[Farmer Cheese Jalapeño Poppers](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-jalapeno-poppers/) is just the recipe to try if you want to spice things up this year for game day in the best way possible, all while being nice to your gut at the same time.


### 2.[High Protein Buffalo Dipping Sauce](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/high-protein-buffalo-dipping-sauce/)


Spicy, creamy, and packed with probiotics and protein, this High Protein Buffalo Dipping Sauce is full of flavor and takes just minutes to make. Simply blend our smooth, cultured[farmer cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) with buffalo sauce and some spices, then serve with veggies, chicken strips, or whatever else you prefer.


### 3.[Buttered Pretzels with Farmer Cheese Dipping Sauce](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/buttered-pretzels-with-farmer-cheese-dipping-sauce/)


Make your own pretzels and dip at home[with this recipe](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/buttered-pretzels-with-farmer-cheese-dipping-sauce/) featuring Lifeway Kefir Butter, and then pair it with a creamy dipping sauce packed with protein from Lifeway Farmer Cheese. Just don’t get it twisted! While this recipe takes some prep time before you’re ready to dig in, the end result is well worth the effort.


### 4.[Easy Farmer Cheese Crust Pizza](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/easy-farmer-cheese-crust-pizza/)


We’ve put a protein-packed spin on the viral cottage cheese pizza crust trend and made it even better with[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) . Our high-protein cultured cheese is blended into the crust of this[Easy Farmer Cheese Crust Pizza](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/easy-farmer-cheese-crust-pizza/) to make a stuffed pizza crust that’s filling, creamy, and more gut-friendly. Give your game day pizza an upgrade with this must-try recipe!


### 5.[Farmer Cheese Pizza Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-pizza-dip/)


This flavor-packed[Farmer Cheese Pizza Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-pizza-dip/) is ideal for game day recipes, or it makes an easy appetizer to serve at parties and gatherings any time of year. Warm, cheesy, and packed with savory flavor, this pizza dip is sure to be a favorite. And since it’s made with Lifeway, you can be sure it’s stacked high with benefits from top to bottom!


### 6.[Jalapeño Popper Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/jalapeno-popper-dip/)


Our Jalapeño Popper Dip is a creamy, savory dip every tailgating spread needs. It’s packed with flavor and nutrition from Lifeway, making it the perfect pairing for chips, pretzels, veggies, crackers, and more. Dip into better with[this flavorful recipe](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/jalapeno-popper-dip/) !


###


### 7.[Kefir Avocado Ranch Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/kefir-avocado-ranch-dip/)


Meet your gut’s new favorite creamy friend packed with protein, fiber, and probiotics. Our[Kefir Avocado Ranch Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/kefir-avocado-ranch-dip/) is a must-try for a richer spin on traditional ranch, all thanks to a base made with probiotic, protein-rich[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) .


### 8.[Open Face Burgers with Farmer Cheese Sauce](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/open-face-burgers-with-farmer-cheese-sauce/)


Anyone can make burgers, but the real secret to this recipe? It’s in the sauce. These burgers feature a flavorful, creamy, unforgettable sauce made with[Lifeway Farmer Cheese,](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) which packs these burgers with complete protein and gut-friendly probiotics. Get the[recipe here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/open-face-burgers-with-farmer-cheese-sauce/) .


###


### 9.[Game Day Blueberry Protein Bowl](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/game-day-blueberry-protein-bowl/)


We saved the berry best for last! Upgrade your game day spread with more than wings and pizza, and try our[Game Day Blueberry Protein Bowl.](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/game-day-blueberry-protein-bowl/) This creamy, filling bowl of functional fuel made with Lifeway Farmer Cheese and Fruitist Jumbo Blueberries is a treat for your eyes, gut, and taste buds.
